end.summary:
Practised factorising x² + px + q by finding two numbers with the required sum and product.
Correctly factorised x² + 2x − 15 as (x + 5)(x − 3).
Corrected the mix-up of copying coefficients in x² + 5x + 6; later identified 2 and 3 and wrote (x + 2)(x + 3).
Also factorised x² − 7x + 12 as (x − 3)(x − 4).
Teach-back was not completed.
end.parentNote: Arjun practised checking both the sum and product of the two numbers before writing brackets. They expanded brackets to verify answers and corrected the coefficient-copying mix-up later in the lesson. At home, ask them to factorise a few expressions and say the pair’s sum and product aloud before expanding to check.
